instruction:
A review of the Phase 3 liveness work found four problems. Fix all four.

**W1. The model lock is skipped in sync mode.** `LuthiModel._model_critical_section()` (`sanctuary/core/luthi_model.py`) returns a `nullcontext` when no async learner is attached. But `consolidate()` now runs on a worker thread even with `async_mode="off"`, so it can overlap a loop-thread reader of the living weights. Always return the real `model_lock` (uncontended in sync mode), and correct the comments that claim otherwise.

**W2. Leaked threads can starve consolidation:**
- The `wikipedia` tool (`sanctuary/tools/builtin.py`) calls the `wikipedia` library, whose `requests.get` has no timeout, so a hung fetch pins a worker thread forever. Before each use, wrap the library's module-global `requests` so `get` defaults to a 15 s timeout. Leave the real `requests` module untouched, and make the wrap idempotent.
- `CognitiveCycle` (`sanctuary/core/cognitive_cycle.py`) runs `model.consolidate` on its own single-thread executor instead of the shared `asyncio.to_thread` pool.

**W3. One error freezes the evolution loop.** `ContinuousEvolutionLoop._run_loop` (`sanctuary/experiential/evolution.py`) only catches `CancelledError`, so a single exception in `_step_cells` stops the CfC/affect layer permanently. Catch and log other exceptions per tick and keep going; still re-raise cancellation. Document `supervise()`'s clean-exit assumption in `sanctuary/core/supervision.py`.

**W4. Dead-letter recovery in `AsyncLearner`** (`sanctuary/core/async_learner.py`):
- **Recover before the consumer starts.** At `start()`, put the persisted transitions straight into the queue before the consumer thread starts. Count each in `produced`. Delete the file only after the whole set is queued.
  - If the queue fills, keep the remainder in `dead_letter` and on disk, and log it.
  - A transition that kills the consumer errors once and is dropped, so it can't re-poison every boot. The transitions behind it must survive for the next learner.
- **Load safely.** Persist without `plan_snapshot` (set it to None). Load with `torch.load(..., weights_only=True)` after `torch.serialization.add_safe_globals([Transition])`.
- **Quarantine, don't delete.** A corrupt or unreadable file is renamed to `<name>.corrupt` (e.g. `dead_letter.pt.corrupt`), so it can't recur but isn't destroyed. Recovery then returns an empty list.
pytest_args: not benchmark and not integration and not property

source.subject: fix: Phase 3 review — address Fable 5's four findings (all confirmed)
